name: Klang
description: Klang is the birthplace of bak kut teh. Explore the original pork bone tea and Hokkien heritage around the Klang KTM station, Jalan Besar, and Little India Klang.

name: Melaka
description: Melaka's 600-year Peranakan food heritage around Jonker Street and Harmony Street - a unique blend of Malay, Chinese, and Portuguese influences.

name: Penang
description: Penang has been called the food capital of Malaysia. Our George Town food tours take you through backstreets where hawkers have been frying noodles since 1975. Charcoal-fired char koay teow, family-run chendol stalls, banana leaf rice in Little India, and assam laksa from the stall CNN put on their list of the world's top 50 foods. Small groups, guides who grew up in these neighbourhoods.

name: Kuala Lumpur
description: Kuala Lumpur's food scene runs 24 hours a day. Our KL food tours start at wet markets before dawn and end at Chinatown hawker stalls after dark. Banana leaf rice in Little India, claypot chicken rice in Pudu, roti canai flipped by an uncle who has done this for 50 years. Guides who know which stall is worth the queue — and which one to skip.
